meta.name: pomodoro
meta.description: Simple Pomodoro timer for focused work sessions with session tracking and productivity analytics. Use when users request focus timers, ask about productivity patterns, or want to track work sessions over time. Demonstrates the System Skill Pattern (CLI + SKILL.md + Database).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用番茄钟保持专注，记录并回顾你的工作节奏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用番茄工作法提升专注度并复盘自己的时间分配
copy.tagline_en: Track your focus sessions and uncover your productivity trends
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use the Pomodoro technique to stay focused and review your time usage.

howto.what: 装好后,它可以运行番茄钟计时器,记录每次专注工作的起止时间和时长,查看历史记录,并统计完成率和高效时段,基于数据提出建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求专注计时、询问生产效率规律或提出跟踪工作会话时触发。

say.text: 开始一个25分钟的番茄钟,任务:写周报。
say.note: Claude 会先检查是否已有会话,再开始计时。

say.text: 今天我的专注数据怎么样?
say.note: Claude 会汇总今日完成率、专注时长等。

say.text: 查看我最近7天的专注历史。
say.note: Claude 会按天列出过去一周的会话记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run a Pomodoro timer, log each focus session's start, end, and duration, review history, and compute statistics like completion rate and productive hours to give data-driven suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a focus timer, asks about productivity patterns, or wants to track work sessions over time.

say_en.text: Start a 25-minute Pomodoro for writing the weekly report.
say_en.note: Claude checks for an active session, then starts the timer.

say_en.text: How did my focus time go today?
say_en.note: Claude summarizes today's completion rate and focus hours.

say_en.text: Show my focus history for the last 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude lists last week's sessions with completion status.
